method.state: new in-memory CityEngine and SQLite store; isolated process environment
method.inputs: Two synthetic camera-local people with the same valid MV3DT demo target. Both source frames are ingested at each sequence. Bounding-box x increases by one pixel each sequence. Odd sequences are observations; even sequences use confidence=null, observedThisFrame=false, globalTrackId=null, associationMethod=null and native3D.state=predicted-or-peer.
method.uiBehaviorBasis: Read-only source inspection, not a browser or rendered-UI test

confirmedFindings: Camera-local track identity survives predicted frames; the test does not create new local IDs.
Current backend map hints and fresh tracks alternate 2,0,2,0,2; mapFusion.available alternates true,false,true,false,true.
Velocity requires adjacent observed frames. The alternating sequence leaves both speeds null even when observed positions change.
UI source filters exclude predicted/stale tracks. Both predicted views therefore hide the marker; asymmetric displayed frames can show one local view instead of a joined marker.
Existing 1m join / 1.5m split hysteresis requires currently eligible members and does not preserve shared display membership through missing/predicted frames.
retentionAlreadyPresent: Stable camera-local IDs, last real observation time and prior real-observation trails remain bounded in the engine.
Known inside occupancy can remain unresolved within its rule observation-gap limit; predictions do not create fresh observation evidence.
qualificationLimits: Synthetic rule/display contract evidence only; not model, MV3DT accuracy, real detector scheduling, live FPS, or camera-clock qualification.
No browser flicker rate was measured. A 15FPS display sampling an alternating 30FPS pipeline can alias onto either frame phase.
No code or runtime fix is included. Interval1 must remain diagnostic until display and observation-to-observation speed semantics are deliberately addressed.
